description: This script is part of a test suite for Git commands, specifically testing the combined behavior of '--reverse', '--parents', '--full-history', and other options for 'git rev-list'. It defines helper functions and test cases to verify the correct ordering of commit lists during revision history traversal.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message provided as argument and updates a test file called 'foo'.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Reverses the order of lines from standard input using awk.
